source: CDC — Proper Storage and Preparation of Breast Milk
disclaimer: Storage windows are published general guidance, not advice about your milk or your baby. Check with your own health professional for your situation.
reviewRule: This file is the ONLY place storage durations may live. Changing guidance means adding a new version file and bumping household.guidance_version — never editing values in code or in an old version.

display.rule: Show both dates. Past best-use is presented neutrally as 'past best use', with the guidance limit still shown. The app never declares a container unusable.

notifications.grouping: ONE grouped notification per threshold per household — never one per container.
notifications.copyTemplate: {{oz}} of frozen milk is approaching its best-use date.
